items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: the dean, Dean Hayes at the university arranged... it was decided between my mother, my parents, and he that if I passed that I would go

ctx.x: Had you finished high school then about that time?

Yes, I had finished high school. I was in my first year of college. And, uh, the dean, Dean Hayes at the university arranged, it was near the final examination time. And he arranged, it was about three weeks prior to that time, and he arranged that I would take my examinations. And, uh, if I passed the examinations, it was decided between my mother, my parents, and he that if I passed that I would go. And if I didn't pass, well, I would have to remain. So, I went. And, uh, that Sunday evening I never will forget,…
I've heard of him. There's nothing about him though, actually.
